items.title: Why Is Caterpillar (CAT) Pushing Ultra Low Methane Gas Compression?
items.summary: Caterpillar (NYSE:CAT) and Phoenix Service Partners reported a breakthrough in ultra-low methane emissions for large-horsepower gas compression systems. The partners are using new engine-mounted integrated oxidation catalyst technology to curb methane and other pollutant emissions at compression sites.
